company.name: Parcelwise
company.oneLiner: Shipping rates, labels and tracking for online stores, through one API

grounding.quote: Parcelwise gives online stores shipping rates, labels and tracking through one API.
The Rates API returns live prices from every carrier in one call.
Print labels for 40 carriers with the Label API.
Tracking Webhooks tell your store the moment a parcel moves.
Now with Canada Post and DHL Express.

bug.title: Fix rounding on multi-parcel rate quotes
bug.summary: Quotes for orders with more than one parcel rounded each parcel up before adding them, so totals ran a few cents high. Totals now round once, after the sum.
progress: Reproduced the gap with a three-parcel order
Compared 37 saved quotes with carrier invoices
context: 37 of 37 saved multi-parcel quotes now match the carrier invoice to the cent.

migration.title: Add an index for webhook delivery lookups
migration.summary: Looking up a parcel's webhook deliveries scanned the whole table. A new index on parcel and time makes the lookup direct.
migration.ask: Run the index migration on staging?
progress: Timed the lookup on a copy of production
Changed the lookup to use it
context: On a copy of production the lookup went from 3.1 seconds to 40 milliseconds across 4.2M deliveries.
Nothing changes in production until you say so.

files.said: Index deliveries by parcel and time, built without locking the table.
rows: IS 'Tracking Webhooks history for one parcel';

files.said: Read the newest deliveries for a parcel through the new index.
rows: export async function deliveriesFor(parcelId: string, limit = 50) {
const rows = await db.query('SELECT * FROM webhook_deliveries WHERE parcel_id = $1', [parcelId]);
return rows.sort((a, b) => b.sent_at - a.sent_at).slice(0, limit);
'SELECT * FROM webhook_deliveries WHERE parcel_id = $1 ORDER BY sent_at DESC LIMIT $2',

lines: Every carrier's price in one call

headlines.why: The first leads with one call for every carrier, the second with the cheapest rate, and the third with trust at checkout.

fourth.title: Document how to test Tracking Webhooks locally
fourth.summary: Added a guide for receiving Tracking Webhooks on a laptop with a test parcel. It covers signing secrets and replaying an event.
context: Every example event in the guide was sent and verified against the sandbox.

jordan.title: Write this week's Parcelwise changelog
jordan.summary: Drafted this week's update covering the rounding fix and the webhook guide. Each entry links to its change.
context: The index migration stays out until it reaches production.
jordan.comment: Can you add the new Canada Post rates?

sixth.title: Retry label purchases when a carrier times out
sixth.summary: A carrier timeout used to fail the label purchase outright. Purchases now retry twice with the same request key, so no label is bought twice.
progress: Added retries with the same request key
context: 30 of 30 timeout tests end with exactly one label bought.

maya.title: Debug sandbox label printing
maya.body: Find out why sandbox labels print blank.
maya.ask: I'm stuck on the sandbox carrier key.
maya.summary: Sandbox label printing needs a carrier key she cannot see.
maya.context: Every sandbox label comes back blank because the carrier key in staging expired. Production labels print fine. I need someone with admin access to rotate the sandbox key.
maya.comment: Can you rotate the sandbox key?
